description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Redis-based clustering in Orleans applications. It defines static methods that extend the IClientBuilder interface to add Redis clustering support via dependency injection.

classes.name: RedisClusteringIClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IClientBuilder to enable Redis clustering configuration.

methods.name: UseRedisClustering (overload with configuration action)
methods.description: Configures Redis as the clustering provider with custom RedisClusteringOptions using a configuration action.

methods.name: UseRedisClustering (overload with connection string)
methods.description: Configures Redis as the clustering provider by parsing the connection string into RedisClusteringOptions.
